# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We as contributors and maintainers of casci pledge to make participation in this
project a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size,
visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and
expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality,
personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our Standards

Behavior that contributes to a positive environment:

- Being respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
- Focusing on what is best for the project and its users
- Showing empathy toward other community members
- Accepting responsibility for mistakes and learning from them

Behavior that is unacceptable:

- Sexualized language or imagery, or unwelcome sexual attention or advances
- Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks
- Public or private harassment
- Publishing another person's private information without explicit permission
- Any conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional
  setting

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces — issues, pull requests,
discussions, and commit history — and when an individual is officially representing
the project in public spaces.

## Enforcement

Report abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior to the maintainers by
opening a private report through the repository's
[report form](https://github.com/webappsgo/casci/security/advisories/new) or by
contacting [@casjay](https://github.com/casjay) directly.

All reports will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly. Maintainers are
obligated to respect the privacy and security of the reporter.

## Enforcement Guidelines

Maintainers will follow these steps in determining consequences:

1. **Correction** — a private written warning explaining the violation.
2. **Warning** — a warning with consequences for continued behavior, including a
   temporary restriction from interaction with the project.
3. **Temporary Ban** — a temporary ban from any interaction with the project.
4. **Permanent Ban** — a permanent ban from any public interaction with the project.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
